$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the first REAL CAPTURE of the evaluation-plan project, produced by the live eval:ci path (tea-ci-runner through the local Claude Code CLI, the harness's own prompt and staged workspace) over the skill with step-03b-render-evaluation-plans.md.

The run found evals/grader/ci/evaluation-ci-plan.json without being told where it was, wrote an evaluation-pr job beside the test job, rendered the plan's five pr checks as two steps (the one check command, and the one `ci --tier pr` command the other four checks share), and uploaded evals/grader/runs/ under if: always().

storedOutput.capturedBy: a live `node test/eval-ci.js --agent claude --runs 2 --set evaluation-plan-quarry-grader` run on 2026-10-01 (8 of 8 requested elements, 0 unrequested, stable across both repetitions, every threshold met), whose staged workspace and prompt were run once more by hand through cli/ci-runner.js and the local Claude Code CLI because the harness discards the workflow it scores; the file is the by-hand run's, byte for byte

derivation: The file parses and actionlint reports nothing. All eight requested elements are present: the pull_request trigger scoped to main, contents:read, the Node version from .nvmrc, npm ci and npm test, both distinct pr commands of the plan, each invoked by exactly one run: block that holds that command alone, and the upload of runs/ under always().
Zero unrequested elements and zero rule violations: the only upload is the requested one, and the evaluation steps carry no continue-on-error.
